name: Kazhdyj den' neverojatnee, chem predyduschij
source:
You have to play for the main character, named Sergei. He is a strong guy, but there is one but, he is lazy and neurotic and a homebody, he even forgot what a woman's caress is. Sat at home doing constant self-medication, just not to go out into the white light from home, to people. And he gave up his job a long time ago, and he is trying to make money on the internet. But all these efforts are in vain. And then one day he still gathered his will into a fist and went to get a job. And then his life regained its colors, positivity and adventure. Not without romance with girls.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714730/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你必须扮演主角，名叫谢尔盖。他是个坚强的男人，但有一个，就是懒惰、神经质、宅男，甚至忘记了女人的爱抚是什么。坐在家里不断地进行自我治疗，只是不要出去到家里的白光下，到别人那里去。而且他早就放弃了工作，开始尝试在网络上赚钱。但所有这些努力都是徒劳的。然后有一天，他仍然将自己的意志握成拳头，去找一份工作。然后他的生活又恢复了色彩、积极性和冒险精神。并非没有与女孩的浪漫。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714730/]Steam[/url]]
